about_the_game:
Get a sneak peek of the full game in The Second Circle Demo. Play through the specifically designed demo level to test out the fast paced combat and fluid parkour!

The Sword, The Crossbow and all The Deadly Abilities

Play through the demo with the quick one handed sword to melt down your enemies in close combat or stun them with your high impact crossbow and then rush in for an execution. Mix your weapons with the deadly abilities available in the demo, grapple them with your hook or knock them them in the air with your heavy punch without giving them a chance to counter!

Full Parkour & Movement Abilities

From Wall running to throwing grappling hooks and quickly sliding or even using your enemies as means to reach your destination, the demo lets you experience all the full movement mechanics of the full game and the adrenaline of dodging your enemies and then finishing them of in the most stylish way possible!

Style Ranking

Finish the demo as quickly and stylishly as possible, mix together your weapons, abilities and movement mechanics to create unique stylish combos, achieving the highest style ranking in the demo!

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 64 bit or Later
  • Processor: Intel i5 2300 @ 2.8GHz / AMD FX 6100 @ 3.3 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 980 / AMD R9 290X
